source_text: Recharge of Rs.75.00 successful for 0711234567. Thank you for using SampleTel.
notes: A biller's own receipt for a bill paid from a bank account. The bank sends its own debit message for the same payment; §8 pairs the two into one transaction, so this message names what the money was for and never the account it came from. 0711234567 is a phone number, not an account suffix.
